author: Zebra79
quote: Everything about you as a human is something we have the right to arbitrate on. This cultural item developed at immense expense is the modern vehicle of enforcing an ideology on 50% of the population that it’s now acceptable to attack psychically. Something has to change. Don’t let them fool you, you have done nothing wrong. It’s not your fault these angry and insidious actors have permeated the seems of the institutes that produce the things that make us happy. It’s not our fault they hate us. Stay strong and reject propaganda like this game spat out to brainwash you by old dinosaurs like rockstar. Look to the new generation of people creating actual art.
